entities.summary: Jonathon Gary Frank Mirasty is a Cree Canadian former professional ice hockey player who has played in multiple leagues including the KHL, AHL, and ECHL. Nicknamed "Nasty" by both teammates and fans, Mirasty developed a cult following throughout his career due to his Mohawk hairstyle and his laughing during his fights.
